_comment: The CURATED candidate list. Human-authored input to the build; everything downstream
(resolution, the packwiz pack, the docs) is generated from it.
Format: categories -> mods -> [slug, why, tier].
tier 'core'   = the pack is pointless or broken without it
tier 'major'  = a headline feature of its theme
tier 'minor'  = flavour/convenience, first to be cut for budget
tier 'risky'  = wanted, but a known stability, balance or compatibility hazard
Revision 2: slugs corrected against the live Modrinth API, dead candidates removed,
and the 1.21.1 catalogue's actual strengths folded in (the Ars addon family, the
NeoForge gun ecosystem, and a far deeper horror layer than the wishlist assumed).
Sidedness is NOT declared here - it is read from Modrinth metadata at generation time.
budget_note: Raised from 400 to 450 (Ethan, 2026-07-31) AFTER the category review, on the reasoning that mod count is not itself a performance limit - load time and RAM are, and there is 61.6 GB here with more on the dedicated box. The trim happens AFTER the cave-generation test world, so cuts are made on what actually breaks or underdelivers in a real world rather than on guesses about value.

Kept here as a record of what was considered and rejected, not as a to-do list.

_comment: Shader packs are a different Modrinth project type: they resolve against the 'iris' loader, not
'neoforge', and install to shaderpacks/ rather than mods/. Shipping them in the pack means nobody
has to find and download one - they just pick from the list in Video Settings.
Iris and Euphoria Patches are already in the mod list; Euphoria is what gives Complementary its
Distant Horizons support.
None is enabled by default - a shader is a per-machine performance decision, and four people have
four different GPUs.
packs: The all-rounder and the safest default. Euphoria Patches (in the pack) gives it Distant Horizons support, which most shaders lack
The classic. Bright, colourful, well-optimised - the gentlest on frames of the four
Soft, warm, stylised. Cheaper than it looks
Chocapic-derived and the most dramatic of the four - strong shadows and volumetric light, which suits the horror layer. Also the heaviest; expect to lose frames

Fabric API and QSL were correctly excluded - multiloader jars declare them even though no NeoForge build needs them.

Required by chunk-loaders, moving-elevators, rechiseled, trash-cans

Required by revervox - the mod that records your friends' voices
Required by the Alex's Mobs community port

create.desc: Pillar 1: Create and its addon family - the industrial spine. Addons WIDEN Create rather than bolting a competing tech mod alongside it. TECH CEILING (Ethan, 2026-07-31): steam and early electricity. Oil, diesel, concrete and sci-fi digital storage are out of period; electricity survives as a late-game marvel rather than a baseline.
mods: Create Crafts & Additions - kinetics to electricity. The top of the tech ceiling
Industrial decoration; makes Create bases look intentional
Buildable artillery. Black powder is period-correct - this is the in-band answer to modern weapons
Community 1.21.1 port of Steam 'n' Rails - trains, couplers, signals
Buildable airships. Explicitly requested; the single most on-period Create addon there is
Automatable enchanting - the bridge from industry into magic
Automates Farmer's Delight cooking with Create
The QoL blocks Create itself lacks; highly configurable
Flight from a pressurised-air backtank, not an energy cell. Rocketeer, not Iron Man
In-world chunk loading, instead of a cheat command
Remote and unloaded storage networks in Create's own idiom. Replaces AE2's FUNCTION without importing its science fiction
Create: Copycats+ - the building addon Create players treat as mandatory
Pipe organs. Audio immersion that is exactly this period
Fixes Quark chests on contraptions - and Quark is in the pack
Oxidation recipes for all copper blocks
Create: Interiors - furniture in the Create idiom
Repeating schematics - big builds without RSI
Create-styled currency; groundwork for a server economy
Tools, armour and gadgets in Create's style

Create: Storage - storage boxes and backpacks built as a Create addon, so portable storage progresses INSIDE the industry pillar rather than beside it. Chosen over Traveler's and Sophisticated on the kinetic ruling
Create end-game items gated behind the Deep Dark. Literally encodes 'the deeper you go, the more advanced the tech' into the industry pillar's own progression
Real elevators for tall Create bases
Villager handling without the boat-based war crimes
Resource crops - the automation sink Create wants
In-game camera and shareable photographs. Photography is 1840s technology - it fits the band

magic.desc: Pillar 2: Ars Nouveau as the magic spine plus a deliberately chosen set of addons. Ars Creo and Create: Ars Nouveau are the explicit seam between the magic and industry pillars - spells that drive machines, machines that fuel spells. DEPTH RULING (Ethan, 2026-07-31): the Ars spine plus FOUR strong alternatives - Iron's Spells (combat magic), Goety (necromancy, feeds the horror pillar), Occultism (summoning), Theurgy (alchemy). Malum, Forbidden Arcanus and Hexerei were cut as a fifth, sixth and seventh parallel progression that four players would never finish. Ice & Fire, Vampirism and Werewolves stay as world-content rather than competing spell systems.
mods: The magic pillar - spell crafting and magical automation
The Ars/Create bridge. The single most on-theme mod in the pack
Second Create/Ars integration - gears meet glyphs
Lets Ars take recipes from other mods - important at this mod count
Bridges Ars Nouveau and Iron's Spells into one progression
Polymorph support for Ars storage lecterns
Deployable magical defensive turrets - magic answer to the gun track
Fixes and expands the storage lectern UI
Ars ingredients in the Farmer's Delight cooking system
Classic RPG spellcasting - the combat-facing magic
Necromancy and dark rituals. Sits exactly on the magic/horror seam
Bridges Cataclysm bosses to Iron's Spells
Classical alchemy - replication and transmutation. The one alchemy system, chosen over Parachymistry and Reactive for depth
Custom summoning rituals for items, mobs and commands. Not a parallel system - a primitive, and a clean future DM lever
Rustic hearths, successor to campfires. Atmosphere, not a progression tree
Deterministic enchanting - removes the slot machine
Tells you what an enchantment does. Non-negotiable at this mod count
Soul fire as a real damage source
Recover enchantments instead of wasting them
Become or hunt vampires - magic that feeds the horror pillar
Affixed loot, enchantment overhaul, bosses - deepens magic and combat together

combat-guns.desc: Pillar 3a: the brother's track, rebuilt to the period ruling. PERIOD (Ethan, 2026-07-31): preindustrial-to-fantasy, with TaCZ as the ONE sanctioned anachronism - one deliberate exception reads as intentional, four read as an accident. Modern warfare, tactical gear and electronic security are out. PRESENTATION RULING: melee is chosen for MOVESETS AND ANIMATION, not stat lines - a weapon that Epic Fight cannot animate is a differently-coloured sword and does not earn a slot. EASE RULING (delegated to Claude): one system per verb. One dodge, one parry, one camera - nobody should have to bind twelve keys to fight.
mods: Community NeoForge port of Timeless and Classics Zero. The single sanctioned anachronism; the official build never left 1.20.1 Forge
A natural gunpowder source - ammo economy without creeper farming
Souls-like combat: weapon-specific movesets, stances, combos, its own dodge and battle camera. The animation ENGINE the whole melee pillar is built on
Iron's Spells casting animated in Epic Fight's style, so magic and melee read as one system instead of two
Scales mobs' Epic Fight attributes to player progression, so the combat system stays meaningful past the early game
Pufferfish's Skills - a fully configurable skill system. Real character specialisation, authored by us, and an obvious future DM hook
Parrying, shield tiers and enchantments. The ONE parry system - Shield Parry was cut so there is a single timing window to learn
Animated armour sets drawn from real cultures. Presentation, not +1 protection
Trebuchet, catapult, ballista, battering ram, mortar. The in-period answer to artillery; pairs with Create: Big Cannons
The definitive medieval arms and armour set, and it carries Epic Fight support
Vanilla-faithful armour sets with real identity
Enemy traits and difficulty progression - the knob that keeps combat scary at hour 200
Mobs get stronger the longer the world runs. A time-based difficulty curve, and an obvious future DM lever
Hard dungeons, real bosses, powerful rewards. The combat centrepiece

Cameras, mines, laser grids, keycards - RESTORED under the buried-tech ruling as salvaged security systems from the underground facilities. Also the pack's only real base defence against the horror layer
A dragon fight worth four players
Entity health readouts; matters when fights last minutes
Swing through grass instead of mowing lawns mid-fight
See your own body - no keybind, pure presentation
Third-person animation coverage for everything Epic Fight does not touch
Over-the-shoulder camera for exploration. The ONE camera mod - Epic Fight supplies the battle camera itself
30+ armour sets earned through a quest chain
Combat and exploration enhancement for the overworld

horror.desc: Pillar 3b: horror. Built from stalkers, atmosphere and escalating pressure rather than jump-scares, so it stays frightening over a long server. Several entries are configurable ambient systems rather than mobs - exactly the surface a future dungeon master would drive. STALKER RULING (Ethan, 2026-07-31): all six hunting entities stay, staggered in config so at most one or two can be active at a time - see docs/06-BURIED-TECH.md and pack/config. Six simultaneous stalkers is comedy, not horror; the config IS the feature. THE BROKEN SCRIPT WAS CUT ON SAFETY, NOT PERIOD: the author states the mod WILL grief the world, WILL destroy buildings, can ban you from your own save and writes files to the desktop. Disqualifying for a shared long-running world.
mods: An unpredictable human-like stalker that follows and visits
A stalker whose behaviour escalates with every encounter
A skinwalker that impersonates other mobs
Player-like figures that watch from a distance and never approach
Do not blink, do not look away
40 cryptids and 50 world events. The single largest horror content mod available
Fully configurable ambient horror, server-side. Pure DM surface: events without client mods
Records and replays your friends' actual voices back at you. With proximity voice chat, the most effective horror mod in the pack
Atmospheric spirits - ambient dread rather than a monster
A Fear Level system that reacts to player behaviour. Explicitly stateful, and a natural DM input
Slowly drives the world into chaos over time
Ambience-led horror with its own dimension
Phobia-grade arthropod horror and supernatural bosses
A spreading fungal infection. The closest 1.21.1 has to Scape and Run: Parasites
A Nether-born virus that escapes into the Overworld and spreads
Abandoned watchtowers in forests - atmosphere in worldgen
Farmer's Delight dishes made from hostile mob drops. Grim, and it ties horror to the food economy
Remote camera drones and cave vision, reframed as SALVAGE from the buried facilities. Gives players reconnaissance tools instead of being purely prey - and its modernity is the point, not a flaw
Periodic horror messages in chat. Trivial, disproportionately effective, and an obvious DM hook
Blood moons and lunar events - scheduled, world-wide dread
Screen damage, blur and blood. Turns being hurt into an experience
Zombies track by blood scent, sound and light. Makes ordinary nights tense
A serious roster of new undead
Aggressive nightmare mobs with unusual mechanics
Config surface for Born in Chaos - required to tune it down from absurd
Spiders that move like spiders. Genuinely worse
Deep Dark expansion - the warden's world made larger
Cave expansion with an eerie register
Real reverb and occlusion. The highest-value horror mod in the pack, and it is a sound mod
Held-torch lighting. Darkness only frightens when light is a resource you carry
Precise control over what spawns, where and when. The tuning knob the whole horror layer depends on
Mobs claw out of the ground instead of popping in
Your body stays where you died - a walk back into the dark to retrieve it

world-structures.desc: Worldgen and structures, chosen as ONE coherent set: BWG for biomes, the YUNG suite for vanilla structure overhauls, and a small number of dungeon and settlement mods. Deliberately not stacking competing terrain generators.
mods: Witch hut overhaul - thematically perfect here
Overhauled cave generation, underground lakes and lava oceans. Same author as Cave Biomes and designed to work with it
Underground biomes AND underground dungeons. The most direct vessel for the buried-tech device - dungeons are where the salvage goes
Cave overhaul with tool progression and mining strategy. Makes descending a deliberate activity with its own tech tree, which is what the buried-tech ruling needs to be worth doing
An entire forgotten dimension deep underground. Thematically it IS the lost world beneath

ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages. Replaced Epic Structures: Villages (9.6M downloads vs 194k) - on a surface that is now PEACEFUL and medieval, villages become the centre of play, so this layer had to be the well-trodden one
Overhauls the Ancient City and adds its portal. The Ancient City is already Minecraft's buried-civilisation set piece; this makes it the gateway
Overworld wilderness overhaul - many animals, ambience, biome life. A surface with no hostiles needs to be FULL of something, or peaceful just reads as empty
Birds, bugs and atmospheric small life. Ambient presence on a surface that no longer has monsters to fill the silence
Animals spawn and despawn like monsters do. Near-mandatory here: with nothing hostile on the surface, hunted animals would never be replaced and the world would slowly empty
Discover animals and monsters with a spyglass and record them. Gives the peaceful surface something to DO between descents
Medieval structures with hidden enemies and treasure. The core of the world-dressing ruling
Seasons with shifting colour and temperature. NOTE: this makes crops seasonal, so it is a real gameplay change on top of Farmer's Delight, not decoration
Shows the current season on the HUD - without it, seasonal farming is guesswork
Loot chests instanced PER PLAYER. Ends the four-player race to the treasure; everyone rolls the same chest independently
Ancient ruins scattered through the world
Small atmospheric structures, very high quality
Outposts that are actually a fight
47 animals with real behaviours - the world feels inhabited
Community port of Alex's Mobs - the biggest creature roster in modded Minecraft
A handful of exceptional set-piece creatures
Hundreds of small vanilla+ additions, individually toggleable
Signs, sconces, flags and dozens of small useful blocks

qol.desc: Quality of life. At 400 mods this is not garnish - it is what stops the pack being unplayable. Recipe lookup, tooltips, sorting, waypoints and death recovery carry the whole experience.
mods: The recipe viewer. Chosen over JEI for performance and its handling of huge recipe sets
Breeding information in the recipe viewer
Search the keybind list. With 400 mods, mandatory
Merges XP orbs - QoL and a real server performance win
Pick up a chest WITH its contents, a machine, or a mob, and walk off with it. The most kinetic storage verb there is, and it needs no UI to understand
Patches Carry On to work with Create Aeronautics contraptions
Bulk storage with contents visible on the block face - storage you can read by looking at it
Fast travel between discovered points. Essential for four players
Trade with every villager in a village at once. With a peaceful medieval surface, villages are now central to play and vanilla trading does not scale to four people
Refresh villager trades without breaking and replacing workstations - removes the single most tedious ritual in modded Minecraft
Sleeping bags and hammocks - four players, four sleep schedules
Find biomes without wandering for an hour
Proximity voice. For four people on a horror server, the highest-value mod in the pack - and half the horror layer depends on it
Gates vein mining behind an enchantment so it is earned
Loading-screen tips - a place to teach the pack's own systems
Custom scripted player avatars. Client-side, so it costs the server nothing and each player controls their own presence
Hooks Figura avatars into Epic Fight's animation system, so custom models actually fight properly
Player-made emotes. With proximity voice chat, this is how four people actually roleplay rather than type

Biome and structure-aware ambient soundscapes - wind, water, caves, weather. Completes the audio layer alongside Sound Physics and voice chat, and is arguably the highest-impact immersion mod in the pack
Sounds - 170+ replacement and new sound effects. The SFX layer under the ambience
Presence Footsteps - footstep audio that varies by the surface you are actually standing on. With Sound Physics reverberating it, this is most of what 'the world sounds real' means
Water drips land and settle audibly. Small, and it is what makes a cave sound like a cave
Extra particles and small sounds for events that vanilla leaves silent
Entity Sound Features - per-entity sound variation, so mobs stop sounding identical

Raise Sound Limit Simplified. NEAR-MANDATORY HERE: vanilla caps concurrent sound sources, and Sound Physics + AmbientSounds + footsteps + 170 new SFX will exceed it - the symptom is sounds silently dropping out mid-fight, which reads as a bug in whatever was making them
Selectively muffle individual sounds. With this much audio, the escape valve for whichever one turns out to be maddening
Renders unlit areas as ABSOLUTE darkness instead of vanilla grey murk. Makes carried light a real resource and gives the horror layer somewhere to hide
Hang real images as in-world paintings, server-synced. Four people decorating a shared world with their own art
Tents, bedrolls and campfires. Turns an expedition into an activity instead of digging a dirt hole at dusk - and the buried-tech device depends on people going far from base
Massively increased render distance at low cost. For a world built for atmosphere, seeing the horizon IS the immersion
Resolves conflicting recipes. At 400 mods, collisions are certain
Unifies duplicate ores and ingots. Prevents the five-kinds-of-copper mess
Faces in chat - small, disproportionately social
Removes chat reporting on a private server
The void becomes survivable instead of run-ending

building-deco.desc: Building blocks and furniture. Four players sharing a world need a deep palette or every base looks identical. Every Compat plus the Macaw suite produces an enormous variant space for very little runtime cost.
mods: Thousands of block variants from vanilla materials
Generates the missing wood-type variants across every mod in the pack
Framed blocks - any shape, any texture
Growing, spreading trees - beautiful, but touches worldgen everywhere

food-farm.desc: Farmer's Delight and its ecosystem. This exists because Create: Central Kitchen and Slice & Dice make food a real automation target rather than a chore.
mods: Immersive mob harvesting - quietly grim, which suits the server

performance.desc: Split deliberately: server-side mods cut tick time for everyone, client-side mods keep four very different machines playable. A 400-mod pack without this layer is a slideshow. Note that Sodium and Embeddium are alternatives, not companions - the pack ships Sodium and keeps Embeddium documented as the fallback.
mods: Broad startup and memory fixes; also cuts load time substantially

General tick optimisation. Replaces Radium, which Create REFUSES to run alongside - Create's own manifest says: 'Radium is an unofficial port of Lithium, Lithium is now natively available for NeoForge and does not suffer from the same issues radium does, use Lithium instead.' Found at first boot, not by guesswork
Load My F***ing Tags - stops one bad tag breaking the pack
The profiler. When the server lags, this is how the cause gets found instead of guessed
Chunk pre-generation - eliminates exploration lag spikes
The options Sodium deliberately omits - fog control, particle limits, per-feature toggles. The main dial for trading visuals against frames
A usable options menu for the above. Four people will each need a different settings profile on different hardware
Shader support on top of Sodium
Euphoria Patches - extends Complementary Shaders, and is what gives Complementary its Distant Horizons support. Needed for shaders and DH to coexist
Up to 50% better framerate on Create contraptions WHEN A SHADERPACK IS ON. That is precisely this pack: a Create server, with shaders, rendered next to a running dedicated server
Particle culling and per-type limits. The horror and magic layers emit enormous particle volumes
General render optimisation with no visual cost
Throttles FPS when the window is unfocused
Fixes memory leaks and reduces memory usage
Fixes packet, NBT and timeout problems. Genuinely necessary on packs this large
Cosmetic chunk fade; masks load stutter

server-admin.desc: Server operation, and the beginnings of the AI dungeon master seam. KubeJS is the important entry: it is the scriptable surface a DM would eventually drive, and it costs nothing to include now. The quest engine is the known gap - see curseforge_only above.
mods: Server-side scripting - recipes, custom items and world events in JavaScript. The most plausible execution surface for the future dungeon master

mods: Novelty entity, thin next to Cryptid and The Skinwalker Hunt.
Only meaningful with Tom's Simple Storage, which is cut.
Single-purpose block generation; also drags in its own library.
Narrow readout addon; Create's own goggles cover the need.
Wireless logistics duplicates AE2, which is already in.
Off-theme content pack; a cyberpunk arsenal does not fit an industrial-magic-horror world.
TaCZ content pack - content breadth we do not need on top of four frameworks.
Conflicts with better-combat; the two are alternatives. Better Combat wins on compatibility across 400 mods.
Second camera mod; Camerapture covers photography.
Overlaps The Knocker and Distant Friends; weakest of the watchers.
Second drawer mod alongside Storage Drawers.
Redundant once Superb Warfare, Vic's Point Blank, TaCZ and Create: Gunsmithing are in.
Third boss-stalker; Obsessed and Kenny already cover escalating stalkers.
Instrument mod competing for attention with proximity voice chat.
Early-game smelting tiers that Create obsoletes within an hour.
A milking cooldown is not worth a mod slot plus a library dependency.
Small foraging mod already covered by the Farmer's Delight family.
Gun animation library with no remaining dependent after the framework trim.
Pulls in Embeddium, which competes with Sodium rather than complementing it. Embeddium stays documented as the fallback renderer, not installed.
Fourth overlapping gun framework; community port with the smallest user base of the four.
Long-range voice duplicates Simple Voice Chat's group channels.
Sleep punishment collides with Comforts and with four players on different schedules.
Gimmick that fires constantly and would wear out within a week.
Third storage network alongside AE2 and Sophisticated Storage.
Overlaps Enhanced Celestials' blood moons and no_moon.jar's escalation.

_comment: Applied by tools/apply_audit.py; findings in docs/07-THEME-AUDIT.md.
Cuts are data, not history: delete an entry from CUTS and re-run to restore.
cuts: F9. More netherite tiers - pure numbers, no new behaviour.
F6. Dimension sprawl. Kept only the two dimensions that serve a pillar directly - The Undergarden (buried-tech) and Cataclysm (combat).

F12. Hard-requires 'ars_elemental' [0.7.0.9,), which is CurseForge-only - its own manifest links to CurseForge. Found at second boot. Ars keeps Additions, Creo, Controle, Unification, Ars'n'Spells, Polymorphia, Structurize, Artillery, Technic, Lumos and the lectern fix.

F15. NullPointerException in JsonVillagerLoader during construction. Its shipped config is copy-paste boilerplate (FPS limits, render distance, favoriteServers) in a LIBRARY mod - a maintenance signal as much as a bug.
F9. Tools from boss materials, mostly stat lines.
F3. Duplicate of Create: Power Loader, which is kinetic and Create-native. This one is a generic utility block doing the same verb.
F5. Transitive dependency of Steamworks Realm; also collided with Epic Structures: Villages, which was chosen precisely because it replaces other village mods.
F5. Cost four mods via its dependency chain and directly caused the village collision in F4. Weakest thing in the pack per mod spent.
F12. Needs 'esl', CurseForge-only. Cheapest of the six to lose: Create: Crafts & Additions already provides the electricity tier, so this was a second path to the same capability.

F14. RuntimeException: Attempted to load class net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/Screen for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER. Painful loss - this was the wuxia specialisation layer Ethan chose to make melee about movesets rather than stat lines. Epic Fight itself still supplies movesets, stances and combos.
F16. Figura 0.1.6 declares it incompatible with the reason 'This addon's features are already included in this Figura version!'. Adding it was my error; the mod's own manifest is the authority.
F2. Duplicate of Corpse. Kept Corpse - retrieving your own body from where it fell suits the horror layer better than a tidy headstone.
F12. Needs 'extensibleenums', CurseForge-only. Costs one mob roster out of many.

F17. Crashes the client every tick: IllegalStateException 'Cannot get config value before config is loaded' in JNEClientEvents.onClientTickPost. Only BETA builds exist for 1.21.1 (2.4.0-BETA.1 through .7), so there is no stable version to fall back to. Proven by crash-2026-07-31_22.16.18-client.txt, not guessed.
F14. Same DEDICATED_SERVER crash. One stalker of six, and the least distinctive; The Knocker, Obsessed, The Skinwalker Hunt, Distant Friends and Weeping Angels remain.
F9. Gem-based gear upgrades are pure numbers. R4 cut Simply Swords and Medieval Craft for the same reason; Apotheosis already supplies affixed loot for progression.
F6. Dimension sprawl - an End overhaul serving no pillar.

F13. Modrinth tags it 1.21.1 + neoforge, but the jar is a multi-version build (26.2) carrying neoforge.mods.toml, mods.toml AND fabric.mod.json plus 1.21.5/1.21.11 overlay folders. NeoForge rejects it outright: 'not a valid mod file'. Same class as zoniex. Base Structory stays and works.
F6. Dimension sprawl - no connection to any pillar.

F15. Its required library better_lib crashes the dedicated server during mod construction (NPE in JsonVillagerLoader - dereferences a null JSON). Re-added for the underground-city idea, dropped again on evidence. The buried city is still served by Underground Worlds' dungeons, Arda's Sculks' Ancient City overhaul, and The Undergarden.
